phenotype_specificity.statement: Carriers have Behçet-like features (fever, oral/genital/gastrointestinal ulcers), which the papers describe as typical of HA20; P13 also had nephrotic syndrome and P41 chronic hepatitis. No paper states other genes were tested and negative for these people. 40574834 notes a normal IFN score in carriers of p.E192K or p.C243Y.

Nineteen patients were evaluated for the type I IFN score, of whom 16 patients had an elevated IFN score and three patients carrying missense variants p.E192K or p.C243Y exhibited IFN levels within the normal range (Supplementary Table 2, Supplementary Figure 3).

segregation.statement: Shigemura family (as re-tabulated): index case plus the mother and three other relatives carry the variant and all have ulcers (37342083). 34011076 lists five affected members under its 'Family 3' but prints the variant only in the first row. 40574834 lists two affected carriers in F5 (P13, P14). No unaffected tested relatives are described in the batch papers. Family F25: only P41 listed.

functional.statement: Construct studies only. In 33549127 (A20-deficient HEK293 cells, used as an earlier-reported comparator): Cys243Tyr disrupted NF-κB reporter inhibition with MYD88 or CARD11 gain-of-function co-transfection; protein expression mildly reduced; IKKβ-mediated Ser381 phosphorylation reduced; deubiquitination like wild type. 37342083 summarises the original report (Shigemura 2016, not in batch): reduced A20 expression and reduced NF-κB inhibition in vitro, with a 10-fold expression increase needed to compensate.

quotes.quote: The inhibitory effect on NF-κB reporter gene activity was also significantly disrupted by TNFAIP3 missense variants Cys243Tyr, Met476Ile, and Thr647Pro, which were previously reported, upon stimulation with co-transfection of MYD88 or CARD11 GoF mutant.
Among the previously reported missense variants, the protein expression level of Cys243Tyr was mildly reduced and that of Thr647Pro was reduced compared with those of the WT (Fig. 2d).

IKKβ-mediated A20 phosphorylation of known pathogenic mutation Cys243Tyr was found to be reduced compared with that of the WT, while A20 expression of Cys243Tyr was not reduced compared with that without IKKβ transfection.
The variants Glu192Lys, Ile310Thr, Gln709Arg, and Cys243Tyr did not show differences in deubiquitination from the WT (Fig. 5).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense change, predicted p.(Cys243Tyr) (batch HGVS), in the OTU domain. Disease mechanism as stated in the papers: heterozygous loss of function (haploinsufficiency).

quotes.quote: AbstractA20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is an autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variations in TNFAIP3, the gene encoding the A20 protein.
Glu192 is among the surface residues identified in the ubiquitin-binding region, whereas Leu236 and Cys243 are in the loop between β3 and β4 (Lin et al., 2008).
A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).

As for the missense variations located in the OTU domain, the pathogenic significance is demonstrated for four of them: p.(Glu192Lys) (Kadowaki et al., 2021), p.(Leu236Pro) (reported in this study), p.(Cys243Tyr) (Shigemura et al., 2016), and p.(Leu275Pro) (Aslani et al., 2022) and, which all fulfill the ACMG criteria for pathogenicity (Richards et al., 2015).
the variant Glu192Lys and the known pathogenic mutation Cys243Tyr were associated with retention of this activity
All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: Likely duplicate identities: the Shigemura family appears as 34011076 'Family 3' (HA20-ID0136), 37342083 column 5 (HA20-ID0021 plus four relatives) and 40574834 family F5 (P13 HA20-ID0713, P14 HA20-ID0714; cited to reference 12, Shigemura 2016). 34011076 row 7 (male, 17 yr onset, refractory nephrotic syndrome) and 40574834 P13 (male, 17 yr onset, nephrotic syndrome) are probably the same man.

Onset ages conflict: 37342083 gives the index case's onset as 9 years, while 34011076 and 40574834 give 17 yr for the male with nephrotic syndrome. 34011076 also lists a separate 'Family 1' cited to Shigemura et al. (9-yr-onset male with nephrotic syndrome) with no variant printed, so its table may list the same family twice.
Carriers not in the batch: four further affected members of 34011076 'Family 3' (20 yr F, adolescent F x2, 12 yr F) have no variant printed in their own rows.
33549127 is in the batch but not listed for this candidate; its Cys243Tyr data are construct results used as a comparator, not from a patient in that paper.
Family F25 (P41) has no cited prior report.
37342083 uses NM_006290 (no version); the batch uses NM_001270508.2.
notes_for_panel: Multi-generation Japanese family (Shigemura 2016, original report not in batch) re-tabulated three times, plus one further family (P41). Functional data come from constructs; the original report's own data are only summarised.
